note: Independently re-judged against full RFC 5575 Section 4: The (AFI, SAFI) pair carried in the Multiprotocol Extension Capability MUST be the same as the one used to identify a particular application that uses this NLRI-type. TestFlowSpecIPv4Basic pins IPv4 flow to AFI 1 / SAFI 133; TestFlowSpecVPNFamily pins VPNv4 flow to AFI 1 / SAFI 134 (its additional IPv6 assertion is not evidence for RFC5575). TestRFC5575OpenCapabilityMatchesTransmittedFlowFamily and its second cover build and parse the configured OPEN, negotiate each exact application through capability.Negotiate, publish that same negotiation to both peer and session, and call AnnounceNLRIBatch. Each matched case requires exactly one UPDATE and the complete MP_REACH value, including the literal AFI/SAFI and NLRI bytes. Each crossed-SAFI case requires ErrNoPeersAcceptedFamily and zero connection bytes. The fixture additions retain all old expectations and make the session/peer encoding context agree with the actual negotiation. The producer's exact-family AnnounceNLRIBatch gate and batch writer therefore remain meaningfully exercised. All four prior test keys are preserved by the native writer; the prior audit has no code anchors. The independent Code-1 numeric oracle is a separate RFC5575-4-1 question and is not claimed here. This is a source re-judgment, not a claim that this agent ran tests or observed a red; main must finish and inspect the pending native renewal observations before stamping.
